**My Hub** — the self-hosted family planner PWA.
A private, offline-capable web app that keeps your household organized — tasks, groceries, meals, recipes, pantry stock, calendar, documents, budget, housekeeping, notes, contacts, birthdays and more — in one place, without cloud accounts or subscriptions.
This repository ships the official Docker template for My Hub. The image is published to GitHub Container Registry at `ghcr.io/arpankayastha/my-hub`.
**Support:** open an issue at https://github.com/arpankayastha/my-hub/issues
